events.text: Root cause: geometry intern cache never evicts + slot-named geom keys (player-model-{i}). The stand-in figure's seven cubes interned under keys 0-6 before the export existed; the exported body's first seven parts cache-hit those cubes. Fix: content-hash (Wyhash over verts) in the geom key for player + NPC figure loops, world_loader.zig. Needs host rebuild.

resolution: Diagnosed and fixed the boxy exported player body in the playtest tab. The loader keyed each figure part's geometry by slot index (player-model-{i}) while the geometry intern cache never evicts — so the stand-in figure's seven cubes, interned by any construct that ran before the export was staged, were served forever to the exported body's first seven parts (giant skin-toned boxes over correct lower legs/feet, which sat at ranks past 6 and interned fresh). Fixed by hashing the part's vertex content into the geom key (geomContentHash, Wyhash) for both the player and NPC figure loops: a stand-in-to-export swap or a re-export now interns fresh geometry, an unchanged body still cache-hits. Zig-side change; requires a host rebuild to see it. The camera-inverted follow-up was retracted by the user.
